usageNotes: Use this to read the current DNS resolver configuration (nameservers, search domain) for a specific PDM node. The response includes a SHA-256 digest suitable for optimistic-lock checks before issuing a write. Requires the System.Audit privilege on the node's dns path — token-based auth is supported.

examples.summary: Fetch DNS settings for a PDM node named 'pdm-node1'

tips: dns1/dns2/dns3 and search are optional in the response — a node with minimal configuration may return only one nameserver or no search domain.
Capture the returned 'digest' value before calling a corresponding DNS write endpoint; passing a stale digest will cause the write to be rejected, preventing concurrent config clobbering.
The 'options' field surfaces any extra directives present in /etc/resolv.conf that PDM does not model explicitly (e.g. 'timeout', 'ndots').
